raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Absolute domain scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The box proportions are fixed at 16:2:2, but the physical side length of a coarse-grid cube is not given.",
      "readings": [
        "Coarse cube side 1: domain 16 × 2 × 2.",
        "Coarse cube side 0.5: domain 8 × 1 × 1."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Section 7 defines the domain using equal-sized coarse cubes; Section 7.1 identifies CANT-16-2-2-5. Neither specifies a physical length."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Magnitude of the central cantilever load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The load position and direction are specified, but its magnitude is absent.",
      "readings": [
        "Total force magnitude 1 in consistent units.",
        "Total force magnitude 10 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Section 7 specifies a z-directed load at the middle of the right face; Fig. 2(a) shows an unlabeled downward arrow."
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Prescribed material volume fraction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The volume constraint is defined symbolically, but no numerical volume fraction is supplied for this example.",
      "readings": [
        "Volume fraction 0.1.",
        "Volume fraction 0.3.",
        "Volume fraction 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Equation (1) states sum_i rho_i = V. Section 7.1 and Table 1 provide no numerical V or equivalent fraction of solid volume."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Young's modulus",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No numerical Young's modulus is specified for the elastic material.",
      "readings": [
        "Young's modulus E = 1 in consistent units.",
        "Young's modulus E = 2 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Equation (1) introduces element stiffness matrices K_i, and Section 6.2 specifies the finite elements; neither gives Young's modulus."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The Poisson's ratio needed for the isotropic elastic reconstruction is not specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson's ratio nu = 0.25.",
        "Poisson's ratio nu = 0.30.",
        "Poisson's ratio nu = 0.35."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sections 6.2 and 7.1 describe the discretization and example settings without specifying Poisson's ratio."
    }
  ]
}
